name: Default
shortDescription: Open source email sending platform on top of AWS SES, with a REST API, domains, contacts, campaigns and delivery analytics, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: Sign-in needs your own GitHub App. Create one with the callback URL https://<your-domain>/api/auth/callback/github and the account permission Email addresses set to read-only, set GITHUB_ID and GITHUB_SECRET (or GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET), then redeploy.

Sending needs an AWS account with SES and SNS access. Set AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, redeploy, add the SES settings in the app and request SES production access to leave the sandbox.
The first account to sign in becomes the instance admin; later accounts need a team invitation. Set ADMIN_EMAIL to pick a different admin.
